entries.name: SWE-bench
entries.supported_claim: Repository issues paired with code snapshots and tests.
entries.important_boundary: Dataset results do not automatically transfer to a maintainer’s private repositories.

entries.name: SWE-bench Verified
entries.supported_claim: A curated subset exposed through the SWE-bench project and leaderboard.
entries.best_use: Use when task solvability and clearer grading matter.
entries.important_boundary: It remains a fixed public benchmark with contamination risk.

entries.name: OpenHands evaluation harness
entries.supported_claim: Includes evaluation integrations used by the OpenHands agent project.
entries.best_use: Inspect how an end-to-end coding agent is run against benchmark tasks.
entries.important_boundary: Harness assumptions may be coupled to OpenHands runtime choices.

entries.name: Harbor
entries.supported_claim: Runs agent tasks in isolated container environments with benchmark adapters.
entries.best_use: Unify terminal-oriented evaluations behind one runner.
entries.important_boundary: Adapter availability and task images still need independent review.

entries.name: Terminal-Bench
entries.supported_claim: Evaluates agents on tasks completed through a terminal environment.
entries.best_use: Measure command-line execution beyond patch-only coding.
entries.important_boundary: Terminal success is not the same as maintainable repository change quality.

entries.name: Aider polyglot benchmark
entries.supported_claim: Aider publishes a benchmark and leaderboard focused on code editing across languages.
entries.best_use: Compare model editing performance under one tool workflow.
entries.important_boundary: Leaderboard scores inherit Aider prompts, edit formats, and task selection.

entries.name: HumanEval
entries.supported_claim: Small Python programming problems graded by unit tests.
entries.important_boundary: Function synthesis omits repository navigation and multi-file change work.

entries.name: Inspect AI
entries.supported_claim: Defines datasets, solvers, tools, scoring, and logs for reproducible evaluations.
entries.best_use: Author internal agent tasks with inspectable run records.
entries.important_boundary: It is a framework, not a ready-made repository benchmark.

field_provenance.supported_claim: source-backed at the cited URL, subject to the recorded review date/version
field_provenance.important_boundary: author analysis unless the linked source explicitly states it
